post.description:
Browse or rank players by projected or actual fantasy points in a public league. Pass stat_period explicitly (S_PW_5 = Week 5 projections, S_S_2026 = 2026 season totals, S_W_4 = Week 4 actuals, S_PN4W = next 4 weeks projected, S_PS_2026 = season projected). For rank windows use player_rankings.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

fantasy_team_id.description: Fantasy team id in this league (fteam filter). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,3}$.

league_id.description: Public league id, the number after /f1/ in a league URL (e.g. 2820). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

league_url.description: A league page URL; the league id is taken from its /f1/{league_id} segment. Alternative to league_id. Pattern: ^https?://(www\.)?football\.fantasysports\.yahoo\.com/f1/[0-9]{1,9}(/.*)?$.

nfl_team.description: NFL team filter code from the page's team dropdown (ET_2 = Buffalo). Pattern: ^ET_[0-9]{1,2}$.

offset.description:
Row offset; the page serves 25 rows. Use next_offset from the previous page.

Provider reference: minimum 0; default 0.

position.description:
Position tab: O (all offense), QB, WR, RB, TE, K, DEF... as the league's player list offers. Pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z/]{0,5}$.

Provider reference: default "O".

sdir.description:
Sort direction as the site encodes it (sdir).

Provider reference: allowed values ["0", "1"]; default "1".

sort.description:
Sort key as the site encodes it: AR (actual rank), PTS (fantasy points), NAME, PR (projected rank)... Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9_]{1,12}$.

Provider reference: default "AR".

stat_period.description: Stat period code from the page's dropdown. Projected: S_PW_{week}, S_PN4W, S_PS_{season}, S_PSR_{season}. Actual: S_W_{week}, S_S_{season}, S_AS_{season}. Omitted: the page's default (reported in stat_period). Pattern: ^S_(PW_[0-9]{1,2}|PN4W|PS_[0-9]{4}|PSR_[0-9]{4}|W_[0-9]{1,2}|S_[0-9]{4}|AS_[0-9]{4})$.

status.description:
Availability in this league: ALL, A (available), FA (free agents), W (waivers), T (taken), K (keepers), STATE_IR (available, IR eligible). Watch list (WL) needs a login and is not supported.

Provider reference: allowed values ["ALL", "A", "FA", "W", "T", "K", "STATE_IR"]; default "ALL".
